question: Do you agree to take part?
options: Yes, I am 18 or older and I agree to take part | No, I do not agree
purpose: Informed, voluntary, adult consent before any data is collected
source_or_validation: POPIA consent; wording to be confirmed by PPS

question: Your participant ID
purpose: Links this form to the anonymous in-app results without using a name or email

question: Do you have your own account with a bank or a mobile-money service?
options: Yes, a bank account | Yes, mobile money only | Yes, both | No | Prefer not to say
purpose: SDG 5.a baseline: access to financial services
source_or_validation: Concept follows Global Findex account ownership; wording is ours

question: In the past 3 months, did you put any money aside as savings, even a small amount?
options: Yes, regularly | Yes, sometimes | No | Prefer not to say
purpose: SDG 5.a / 4.4 baseline: saving behaviour (compare with the day-7 follow-up)

question: How much say do you usually have in big decisions about your money?
options: I decide on my own | I decide together with family or a partner | Other people mostly decide for me | It depends | Prefer not to say
purpose: SDG 5.a baseline: women's say over money (compare with D6 at day 7)
source_or_validation: Draft item for this pilot; check against a validated women's economic empowerment measure before publishing

question: How was your experience with each of these?
options: ROWS: Joining a community / The lesson (Now-Now, Stack It, Grow It) / The budget task / The community chat and feed | COLUMNS: Loved it / Liked it / It was okay / Did not like it / I did not try this
purpose: Experience of the four core features, side by side (compare with the in-app success, time and ease per mission)

question: And the extras, if you tried them?
options: ROWS: Payslip simulator / Money Buddy / Letterbox (friends) / Invest HER (simulation) / Talk to someone / Support page and Quick exit / Rewards / Points and badges | COLUMNS: Loved it / Liked it / It was okay / Did not like it / I did not try this
purpose: Experience of the optional features (which to keep, fix or cut)

question: How easy was each of these to use or understand?
options: ROWS: Joining a community / Understanding the lesson / Doing the budget task / Using the community chat / Finding my way around the app | COLUMNS: Very easy / Easy / Okay / Difficult / Very difficult / I did not try this
purpose: SDG 4.6: ease and understandability per feature, including the words and navigation

question: What is Sisi mainly for?
options: Learning about money in plain words and practising with simple tools | Getting personal financial advice | Opening a bank account or taking out a loan | Buying and selling investments with real money | I am not sure
purpose: SDG 4.6: did people grasp the purpose without being told? (Correct answer: the first option.)

question: How well did Sisi speak to women like you?
options: Very well | Fairly well | Not very well | Not at all | I am not sure
purpose: SDG 5 / 4.5: is the content and tone gender-responsive and relevant?

question: What did you like? (Tick up to three)
options: The short, clear lesson | The budget task | The community and chat | The friendly tone | Points, badges or rewards | That it felt private and safe | How simple it looked | Nothing in particular
purpose: Likes, in structured form

question: What did you dislike or find frustrating? (Tick up to three)
options: Words I did not understand | The lesson was too long | Too much text on screen | The budget task was hard | The community felt unclear or awkward | It was slow or did not work well on my phone | Data cost or a weak connection | Something felt unsafe or uncomfortable | Nothing
purpose: Dislikes and friction, in structured form

question: Which ONE part of Sisi was most useful to you?
options: The lesson | The budget task | The community chat | Events | Money Buddy | Letterbox (friends) | Payslip simulator | Invest HER (simulation) | Talk to someone | Rewards | None of them
purpose: Forced choice: preferred feature

question: If we could change only ONE thing first, what should it be?
options: Make the lessons shorter or simpler | Make the budget tool simpler | Make the community easier to use | Add more topics | Make it faster or work better on my phone | Make rewards clearer | Make it feel more like my life
purpose: Forced choice: top priority to fix

question: Points, badges and leaderboards are optional in Sisi. How do you feel about them?
options: They motivate me | I do not mind them | They put me off | I would switch them off | I did not notice them
purpose: Gamification preference (evidence rule: must stay optional, with Focus mode)

question: Compared with before today, how confident do you feel about making everyday money decisions?
options: Much more confident | A bit more confident | About the same | A bit less confident | Much less confident
purpose: SDG 4.4 / 5.a: retrospective self-efficacy change (second estimate beside the in-app before/after)
source_or_validation: Retrospective then/now design reduces response-shift bias

question: Learning about money like this could help me to… (Tick all that apply)
options: Feel less stressed about money | Make and keep a budget | Start saving | Avoid or get out of debt | Start investing | Talk about money with my family | Say no to money requests I cannot afford | Ask for fair pay or fees | Start or grow a business or side hustle | Plan for study or my career | None of these
purpose: Perceived benefit by outcome area: skills (SDG 4.4) and economic agency (SDG 5.a)

question: What would make you most likely to come back? (Tick up to two)
options: Reminders | Rewards or prize draws | Doing it with a friend (Money Buddy) | More topics that fit my life | Lessons in my own language | Shorter lessons | Live sessions or events | Nothing would
purpose: Retention drivers: reminders, rewards, social, content, language, length

question: How safe and comfortable did you feel using Sisi, including the community?
options: Very safe and comfortable | Mostly safe and comfortable | Neutral | A bit uneasy | Not safe or comfortable | I did not use the community
purpose: SDG 5: safe participation for women online

question: What could stop you using an app like Sisi regularly? (Tick all that apply)
options: Data cost | A weak connection | Sharing a phone | Someone else controlling or checking my phone | The language | Not having time | Worry about privacy | Hard to read or tap (text size, colours, buttons) | Nothing
purpose: SDG 5.b / 4.5: access barriers, including the gender digital divide (equity cuts for SDG 10.2)

question: Your participant ID
purpose: Join to the session data

options: Not at all | Once | 2 to 3 times | 4 or more times
purpose: Return use

options: Made or updated a budget | Set a savings goal | Put money aside that I would not have saved otherwise | Started or added to an emergency fund | Talked about money with someone | Done a Sisi lesson with a friend | None of these
purpose: SDG 5.a / 4.4: behaviour change since the session

options: Yes | No | Prefer not to say

options: Much more confident | A bit more confident | About the same | A bit less confident | Much less confident
purpose: SDG 4.4 / 5.a: self-efficacy at day 7 (compare with Q14)

question: Have you used what you learned in a real money decision?
options: Yes, I decided on my own | Yes, together with someone else | Not yet | Not sure
purpose: SDG 5.a / 4.4: skills applied, and who made the decision (compare with Q3; ask for no amounts or names)

question: If you did not use Sisi again, what got in the way? (Tick all that apply)
options: I forgot | I did not have time | Data costs or connection | I did not find it useful | I did not feel safe or comfortable | Technical problems | I did use it again
purpose: Barriers to return

question: Have you told anyone else about Sisi?
options: Yes, one person | Yes, more than one person | No
purpose: Word of mouth (ripple effect)

question: Since the session, does money feel…
options: More manageable | About the same | Less manageable | Not sure
purpose: Self-reported change in how manageable money feels

purpose: Contact channel

options: The 4-week follow-up | The pilot prize draw | Future Sisi testing
purpose: Purpose limitation
